name: 06053 · New Britain, CT
findings: ZIP 06053 (New Britain) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06053 (New Britain) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
